summary: Node/file and cloud-link adapters for the local Project Loro replica.
context_hints: local-api is the machine's durable replica authority; Desktop, CLI and local agents connect to it rather than directly to hosted ProjectRoom.
File writes must complete before a peer or cloud update is acknowledged.
Cloud transport is discovered from the remote profile: loro-streams-v1 uses opaque persisted offsets via the Loro Streams SDK; legacy Loro WebSocket retains VersionVector recovery.
The deterministic chaos suite uses real loopback WebSockets and fixed seeds; do not replace protocol readiness with timing sleeps.

key_files.file-replica-store.ts: Atomic snapshot and framed update-log filesystem storage.
key_files.replica-ports.ts: File storage adapter for the portable ReplicaEngine.
key_files.cloud-replica-link.ts: Reconnectable Node WebSocket adapter for official Loro protocol server-to-server sync.
key_files.cloud-replication.chaos.test.ts: Two durable local replicas and a restartable cloud core under loss, duplicate, reorder, partition, checkpoint, and restart faults.
key_files.cursor-cloud-replica-link.ts: Local Host SDK snapshot/log/SSE recovery and append. No cloud checkpoint computation, timers or upload. Offsets advance after commit; offline upload limit 8 MiB.
